decisions.detail: Owner selected new tenant-transition endpoint plus lifecycle record store as follow-on work in trust-gateway, consulting TG84 TEN-0.1 decision vectors (canTransitionTenant), instead of wiring auto-disable consult or merging as library-only. Rationale: auto-disable consult is vacuous (active->suspended unconditional); library-only leaves vectors unenforced on every live path.

Docs production deploy stays unclaimed. No Cloudflare credentials (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/ACCOUNT_ID) in this environment. PLATFORM-INTEGRATED verdict must record docs as verified-in-CI with deploy pending, never as deployed.
